inventory-sorter.sort_mode.name: Name
inventory-sorter.config.title: Inventory Sorter
inventory-sorter.config.hotkey_info: The sort key is %s. Change it in Options > Controls > Key Binds > Inventory Sorter.
inventory-sorter.config.hotkey_action.to:
What pressing the sort key in an inventory does.
Move All only works in chests, barrels and other containers.
inventory-sorter.config.hotkey_target.to:
Panel under the mouse: the container or your inventory,
whichever the mouse is over (the container if neither).
Container: always the container.
Your inventory: always your own inventory.
inventory-sorter.config.shift_drag.toolt:
Hold Shift and drag with the left mouse button
to move every stack you pass over to the other inventory,
as if you had shift-clicked each one.
Only takes items from the side the drag started on.
inventory-sorter.config.shift_drag_delay:
How long to hold the mouse button before a shift-drag
starts moving the stacks you pass over.
Stops quick shift-clicks from also moving the next stack
when the mouse moves before the button comes up.
inventory-sorter.config.sort_mode.toolti:
Item Type: similar items together (stone, wood, ores, tools...)
Name: A to Z
Item ID: by the minecraft:... id
Count: biggest piles first
Mod: grouped by the mod that adds the item
Right-click a sort button to cycle this.
inventory-sorter.config.reverse_order.to: Sort the other way round, for example Name Z to A.
inventory-sorter.config.include_hotbar.t:
Sorting and Move All on the player inventory
also take the hotbar.
Sorting uses normal inventory clicks, so it works on any server.
Instant sends them all at once.
Lower it if a server's anti-cheat complains.
inventory-sorter.config.player_inventory: Show buttons on your own inventory as well as on the container.
inventory-sorter.config.player_buttons_i:
Also show the player inventory buttons in crafting tables,
furnaces, anvils and other vanilla screens.
